config.aspect_definition: Pre-rotation x/z and y/z affine scale ratios, relative to z-axis global scale.
config.unchanged: Radius, scale, local-rotation, angular-mode, fluence/background bounds; mesh/core/density; angular Tikhonov; original sampled training and full evaluation masks.
config.numerical_change: Increase quadrature4 to selected passing order and transform-axis sampling101 to201 points to cover extreme expanded geometries. Pixel selection is unchanged; separately refit narrow-bound controls to quantify numerical sensitivity.
config.initialization: Medium starts at saved narrow optimum; wide starts at medium training optimum. Both nested ranges are reported, without held-out selection.
config.selection: One local continuation for each bound expansion, with up to160 additional evaluations for incomplete convergence. Minimum penalized training objective retained, including the source optimum.
config.validation: All full-ROI metrics recalculated; eight predetermined exact-boundary controls per range; within-pattern exploratory radial-band holdout.

radius_definition: Mean of least-squares sphere radii over eight deformed corner caps. Effective3D descriptor; not a common local curvature radius.
interpretation_limits: Radius quantiles summarize pattern fits, not confidence intervals for one common radius.
Both aspect expansions are shown; neither is selected on held-out loss. This adaptive follow-up uses the existing209 patterns and old radial-band split, not fresh confirmatory data.
Nested local continuations establish feasible fits, not global optima or unique3D shapes.
The inherited Tikhonov term penalizes four angular shape modes. Aspect ratios have hard bounds but no additional quadratic penalty.
Sphere approximation to deformed caps becomes less exact as anisotropy increases; cap RMS is reported.
Held-out gains versus the rounded grid seed combine several freedoms; they cannot be attributed specifically to rounding.

depth_diagnostic.scope: Fixed-xy diagnostic, no geometry refit. Ewald sensitivity can break planar depth invariance, but its presence does not establish depth identifiability in noisy measured data.
